output.answer: As of the latest FINRA report (settlement date October 30, 2026), Beyond Meat (NASDAQ: BYND) had 6,300,973 shares sold short, up 1.22% from the prior report, equal to roughly 6.30 million shares on a float of about 15.6-16.9 million — about 37-40% of the float. Days to cover stood at 6.62 based on average daily volume of ~951,000 shares. Short interest has been climbing since the company's August 2026 1-for-15 reverse split (it was ~130.5 million unadjusted shares in July 2026), rising every settlement since Aug 31, 2026 (+9.28% on Oct 15 to 6,224,865, then +1.22% on Oct 30). One model estimates ~6.21 million shares for the next (Nov 13, 2026) settlement, with FINRA's official release expected Nov 24, 2026.
caveats: FINRA short interest is published twice monthly; the latest official figure is the October 30, 2026 settlement — the mid-November settlement had not been released as of November 11, 2026, so the true current figure may differ.
Percent-of-float figures differ by provider (MarketBeat 37.36% vs StockAnalysis 39.96%) because they use different float estimates; the share count itself (6,300,973) is the official FINRA figure.

Pre-August 2026 share counts in FINRA history (~130-147 million shares in late 2025 and mid-2026) are on a pre-reverse-split basis and are not comparable to current counts; the apparent 96% drop on Aug 14, 2026 reflects the 1-for-15 reverse split restatement.
